items.description: Estimation windows are selected only from recipe allowlists and must end at the job as-of date.
Covariance estimators are method-specific; clustered inference requires at least eight clusters for a warning and thirty for high confidence.
Only registered transforms may be applied. Winsorization and standardization must be disclosed in lineage.
Natural-language horizon is authoritative. Missing horizon uses a visible workflow policy default.
Missingness never triggers silent imputation across release dates.
